settings.heading: What does membership actually get you?
settings.subheading: Your card works forever with no monthly fee. This is a separate, optional add-on for businesses that want ongoing help getting reviews.
settings.disclaimer: Don't need this? Every card works standalone with no monthly fee — membership just adds ongoing help on top. Cancel anytime.

settings.title: Free card & link updates
settings.text: If your Google review link ever changes, we reprogram your card for free — no charge, no new card needed.

settings.title: 20% off future cards
settings.text: Need a replacement or extra cards for a new station? Members always pay 20% less.

settings.title: Monthly review check-in
settings.text: We check your Google reviews once a month and send you a quick update — like "You're at 4.6 stars with 82 reviews, up 7 this month."

settings.title: Review reminder template
settings.text: Every month we send a ready-to-use text or email script — like "Thanks for visiting us today! Leaving a quick Google review helps our small business a lot."

settings.title: Priority support
settings.text: If your card ever stops working or you need help, members go to the front of the line.

settings.heading: Not sure if you need it?
settings.subheading: Start with a card — no monthly fee — and add the Review Growth Plan whenever you're ready.
